The two by two matrix on p,q has determinant −41/75600 and invertible exact formulas in RESULT.md; s>0,0<p≤s²/4,0≤q<4p is equivalent to a positive definite Gram matrix. Swapping or reversing generators yields only isometric parallelograms. The exhibited (A,B,q)=(3/2,1/2,1) and (7/5,3/5,313/250) share m1=1/3,m2=17/72 with different sixth moments, establishing sharp necessity of three.
